# Control classification and scenario guidance

> This page is plan **A** of `docs/issues/issue-20261115.md` §6.4: a reader-facing map of
> the widget families, with the mechanical half generated instead of typed. Regenerate with
> `python3 tools/gen_widget_classification.py`; `bash tools/check_widget_classification.sh`
> fails when the committed page is stale.

## 1. What the numbers mean (all derived)

| Item | Value | Derivation |
|---|---|---|
| `WidgetKind` variants | 231 | `pub enum WidgetKind` in `src/widget/kind.rs` |
| Registered controls (canonical names) | 243 | `canonical_name:` rows in `src/widget/capability/properties/` |
| Alias names | 202 | `aliases: &[...]` rows in the same tables |
| Families | 18 | directories under `src/widget/` that own a control |

The two totals are **different measurements and neither is wrong**: a kind is an enum
variant (several controls may borrow one kind — the table family, the panels, `stepper`/`mac_stepper`/`step_strip`), while a control is a row in the factory registry.
This page indexes by **control**, because that is what a host mounts.

Suites controls (`crates/rust-widgets-suites`: form, webview, finance, maps, project,
devtools, media playback) are not in this table: they are optional packages installed into
the same factory, and `check_suite_control_count.sh` owns their census.

## 3. Scenario guidance

The **Module gate** column is derived from `src/widget/mod.rs`; the rest is curated advice
(§6.4 plan A). A family gated on `full_widgets` is absent from `mini`/`embedded` wholesale,
so its stripped-profile cell says so instead of repeating a per-control guess.

| Family | Module gate | mini / embedded | desktop | tablet / mobile | Device shape | OS / input notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_widgets/` | `every profile` | ✅ 仅 `toggle_button` 随 `widgets_unstripped` | ✅ 全量 | ✅ 全部可用 | 全形态 | `radio_button` / `check_box` / `toggle_button` 有 touch 分支 |
| `input_widgets/` | `every profile` | ⚠️ 核心子集（`masked_edit` / `otp_input` / `mention` / `cascader` 等不编译） | ✅ 全量 | ✅ 触控友好子集 | 桌面全量；移动取 picker/field 子集 | `shortcut_editor` 强键盘语境；`keyboard` / `ime_preedit` 面向移动软键盘 |
| `container_widgets/` | `every profile` | ⚠️ `scroll_area` / `panel` 可用；tab/splitter/mdi 与布局族需 `full_widgets` | ✅ 全量 | ✅ 移动取 stack/scroll/safe_area | 桌面=dock/mdi；移动=stack/scroll | `safe_area` 是移动安全区；布局族 12 个 kind 在 mini 全部不可用 |
| `display_widgets/` | `every profile` | ✅ 大头可用；`image_view` 的 kind 常驻但 mini 无 `image` feature → 图像源不可用 | ✅ 全量 | ✅ 全部可用 | 全形态 | `rating` / `roller` / `switch` 有 touch 分支；`lcd_number` / `meter` 适合仪表语境 |
| `nav_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量 | ✅ 移动/平板优先 | 移动优先 | `drawer` / `bottom_navigation_bar` 按触控设计；`app_bar` 同时服务桌面 |
| `dialog/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量（`file_dialog` / `font_dialog` 强 OS 语境） | ✅ 移动优先用 `bottom_sheet` / `modal_bottom_sheet` | 全形态 | `color_dialog` / `file_dialog` 桌面语境；`wizard` 适合任意形态的分步流程 |
| `chart_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 含引擎路径（`chart` feature 仅 desktop） | ⚠️ fallback 路径 | 桌面优先 | 金融深度图随 suites；移动端图表走 `chart_widgets/mod.rs` 的 fallback |
| `media_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ `animated_image` / `hero_animation` | ✅ 同左 | 全形态 | 重媒体（video/audio）在 suites 且显式 opt-in，不在任何 device profile |
| `menu_toolbar/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量 | ⚠️ 建议精简（长按菜单 + 少量 action） | 桌面优先 | `menu_bar` / `ribbon_bar` 是桌面习惯；移动端更宜用 `bottom_navigation_bar` |
| `overlay_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量 | ✅ 触控件为主 | 移动/平板 | `fab` / `swipe_to_dismiss` / `refresh_control` 依赖 `touch` feature |
| `view_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 主力（大表强桌面语境） | ⚠️ 仅浏览场景 | 桌面优先 | 键盘 + 滚轮 + hover 是交互前提；`virtual_*` 面向大数据集 |
| `special_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量（两个编辑器各自独立 feature，默认开） | ✅ `canvas` / `signature` / `segmented` 适用 | 桌面=编辑器；移动=canvas/signature | `signature_pad` 依赖 `touch`；`code_editor` / `markdown_editor` 需要键盘 |
| `advanced_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量（`dial` / `pie_menu` / `ribbon_bar` 桌面习惯） | ✅ picker 系（`calendar` / `date_edit` / `time_edit`）触控友好 | 桌面=dial/pie/ribbon；移动=picker | `pie_menu` 是指针语境控件，触控端建议 `action_sheet` 类替代 |
| `cupertino/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ⚠️ 可编译但语境错位 | ✅ iOS 语境最佳 | mobile/tablet | 纯风格族，无 OS cfg → 全平台编译；iOS/Android 只是使用建议 |
| `macos/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 仅 macOS 语境推荐 | ⚠️ 语境错位 | macOS 桌面 | 纯风格族，无 OS cfg；`mac_*` 用桌面度量 profile 绘制 |
| `misc_widgets/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 全量 | ✅ `mobile_date_picker` / `drum_column` 移动最佳 | 移动=picker/qr；桌面=avatar/qr | `avatar` / `qr_code` 依赖 `image`；`barcode_scanner` 是相机语境 |
| `companions/` | `full_widgets` | ❌ whole family is not compiled | ✅ 随宿主控件使用 | ✅ 同左 | 随宿主 | 地图/画布伴生件面向 suites；`step_strip` / `zoom_strip` 等零依赖，可直接挂在任意页 |
| `root/` | `every profile` | ⚠️ `window` 各 profile 均编译；`tool_box` 仅 `full_widgets` | ✅ 全量 | ✅ `window` 全形态 | 全形态 | `window` 是顶层窗口容器；`tool_box` 是桌面工具面板 |

## 4. Adoption record

- **A. This page** — adopted. Cost: generated artefact + one gate; it introduces no second
  source of truth because every number here is recomputed.
- **B. Recommended-profile fields in the capability schema** — deferred (issue §6.4). The
  schema is a runtime export locked by several gates, every row currently means "any",
  and curated advice cannot be machine-verified; there is no machine-readable consumer yet
  (designer/CLI filtering). If one appears, this page stays the only hand-curated source
  and a script derives the schema fields from it.
- **C. A `mini` demo gallery** — optional, deferred. One extra gallery is real maintenance;
  it becomes worthwhile only when someone needs a shippable mini reference.

Per-family `mod.rs` header comments are deliberately **not** part of this round: they would
be a second copy of §3 with no gate behind them.
